subject: Pen test + SOC2 evidence onboarding with SecStream / PenTest Partners
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@pentestpartners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@secstream.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + evidence exchange + tentative pen test window

Hi Karthik / Olga —

SecStream engaged PenTest Partners to run a targeted external/internal pen test and a small web app code review for their inference control plane. We need to coordinate evidence access and an artifact handoff process so our testers can validate remediation during the test window (target week of Aug 23).

High-level ask:
- Provide (read-only) access to SOC2 evidence packages or an upload endpoint for our investigators to pull artifacts (logs, config snapshots, change logs, sample compliance reports).
- Confirm acceptable redaction rules and the preferred evidence exchange method (SFTP, temporary S3 read-only creds, or a GRC connector).
- Point us to a technical contact and the gating process (NDA, JML approvals).

We can run under the NDA we uploaded; I can send a DocuSign link for signatures if needed.

Attachments: scope-sheet.xlsx (draft scope)

Thanks — Amy
Amy Chen
Engagement Manager, PenTest Partners
amy@pentestpartners.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@pentestpartners.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange + tentative pen test window

Amy — really glad you reached out. Welcome — we want to make this as frictionless as possible. Proposed plan:

1) Evidence exchange method: we prefer a short-lived S3 bucket with read-only credentials scoped to the evidence folder, or our GRC connector (API key) if you can push artifacts directly. We do not recommend SFTP unless absolutely necessary.
2) Evidence taxonomy + redaction: see attached onboarding-checklist.pdf for what we accept for SOC2 reviews (PII redaction, log time ranges, hashed ids).
3) Technical contact: Olga will lead collection and scoping, Vivek is on the security approvals side.
4) Legal gating: send the DocuSign NDA link and the HubSpot deal id back to me so we can link approvals to the ticket.

Proposed next steps: you send preferred transfer method + NDA link. Olga and I will provision the temporary bucket/API key and share read-only creds via our secrets workflow (one-time secret in 1Password + audit log).

I attached the draft scope you shared and a checklist we use internally.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf, scope-sheet.xlsx

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy@pentestpartners.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange + tentative pen test window

Thanks Amy — a couple of clarifications from the GRC side:

- Evidence packages: please request records by category (e.g., access logs, config snapshots, SOC2-runbooks, vulnerability scan exports). We will provide CSV manifests for each package.
- Redaction rules: PII must be removed or tokenized; we will include a redaction manifest for traceability.
- Retention: evidence folders will be available for 30 days after the test window closes.

I've uploaded a redacted asset inventory stub to the shared Drive and attached a redacted CSV for your review. Once we confirm scope, I will create a one-time S3 URL and an audit ticket.

Attachments: redacted-asset-inventory.csv

Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + evidence exchange + tentative pen test window

Perfect — thanks for the clear runbook. We prefer to pull artifacts, so the short-lived S3 bucket with read-only creds sounds best. A few notes:

- We need a bucket that contains: webserver logs (last 90 days), auth logs, vulnerability scan exports (Nessus/Qualys), and a sample change-log for the infra team.
- If an API push is easier for Redwood, we can accept uploads to a GRC endpoint; can you share the upload schema?
- We'll sign the NDA — here is the DocuSign link for our side: https://www.docusign.com/secure/rdw-nda-1923

If possible, please provision credentials by Aug 16 so our team can sync the pulls with our scheduled discovery (week of Aug 17) and run the tests Aug 23–27.

Thanks — I attached a cleaned scope-sheet with our required artifact list.

Attachments: scope-sheet.xlsx

Amy — all good, we will proceed with the S3 approach. Final items and owners: 

- Legal: sign DocuSign NDA (link below) — Amy to confirm signatures so we can attach to the HubSpot record.
- Technical provisioning (owner: Olga) — create one-time read-only S3 creds and upload manifest (delivery target: 2026-08-16).
- Security approvals (owner: Vivek) — short review of requested artifact list and any compensating controls; timing: review by 2026-08-12.
- Evidence retention: S3 folder will be auto-archived after 30 days and access revoked.

Related links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1923, DocuSign NDA https://www.docusign.com/secure/rdw-nda-1923, Shared drive https://drive.redwood.io/shared/SecStream-Onboard

I'll mark the ticket and send the provisioning request to infra once the NDA is returned. Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth handoff.
